verdict.rationale: The only in-product AI assistance on the user's own data is the ability to 'debug these errors with AI' on surfaced workflow errors and stack traces. That is a narrow, error-scoped form of AI suggestion. The 'prompt, run, edit, and deploy AI agents' claim is about building agents, not about the product generating insights from user data. Missing for 10: AI-generated insights or analysis over workflow or event data, proactive suggestions beyond error debugging, any detail on how the AI debugging works, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
